d: In this video, Firstpost’s James Gooderson examines the final build-up to the US midterm elections. With just two days until Election Day, President Donald Trump makes a last-minute U-turn over planned rallies in Iowa and Kansas, two traditionally Republican states now seen as competitive. Republicans face voter concerns over the cost of living, inflation, and fuel prices amid the Iran war. Meanwhile, Democrats are dealing with a bitter internal feud between establishment and progressive candidates in Michigan.
